name: img-tabs-standalone
title: Image Tabs Standalone
description: Three bold questions stack down the left of a dark stage; choosing one outlines it in blue, drops a short answer underneath and shows a large rounded photo on the right.
use: A handful of detailed questions each need a short answer and an illustration next to it.
avoid: The rows only answer mouse clicks, and the photo box is a fixed 400 px tall, so wide images get cropped.
a11y: Rows are clickable divs with no tab role or tabIndex, so the switcher is mouse only; the photos do carry alt text. (keyboard: no, labels: partial, reduced motion: not handled)
looks: A narrow left column of three heavy white question rows on near-black, the active one ringed in cobalt blue and filled deeper navy, with a white answer block hanging under it. The right half is one large rounded photo.
behaves: Clicking a row opens its answer with a quick height fade and swaps the right-hand picture to that row's image, fading the old photo out. The blue outline stays on the chosen row until another is clicked.
customise: There are no props: questions, answers and photo links sit in the tabs array in the file, and the blue outline and fixed heights are hard-coded classes.
weight: light: One photo and one expanding panel at a time, with short fades.
